source: A real capture (2026-10-29, RyzenShine): the Keychron Link dongle 3434:d030 with a K2 HE on the community battery firmware, its raw HID node (usage page 0xFF60, usage 0x61) read for 75 s with the keyboard at rest. `pushes` are what the keyboard sent by itself, in order (run 2, at 11.8, 13.8, 15.8, 41.8 and 43.8 s; change pushes land on a 2 s grid, the 30 s heartbeat repeats the last). The dongle answered no request (a 0xA4 request written to it got nothing in 3 s): no exchanges.
